medium_decision.reason: The approved slot requires an original image-led concept rather than factual interface evidence or an editable diagram.

asset_lock.composition: One dominant subject with asymmetrical negative space reserved for interface copy.
asset_lock.subject: State the approved project-specific subject without adding unsupported people, products, or claims.
asset_lock.color: Use the approved semantic color roles and preserve accent scarcity.
asset_lock.lighting: Name the approved lighting direction and contrast behavior.
asset_lock.visible_text: No generated text unless the exact words and placement are explicitly supplied.
allowed_variation: Vary secondary detail without moving the subject or copy-safe region.
prohibited_drift: Do not replace the approved composition with a centered stock-image layout.
Do not add decorative accent colors outside their semantic role.
Do not introduce unapproved logos, words, or product claims.
verification_criteria: The primary subject and copy-safe region match the locked composition.
Color roles match DESIGN.md and the token source.
No unapproved text, logo, person, or product detail appears.

prompts.gpt_image_2: Create one image concept using the exact asset lock above. Preserve the dominant composition, material language, semantic color roles, copy-safe region, and all prohibited-drift rules.
prompts.midjourney: Create one image concept with the locked subject hierarchy, asymmetric composition, approved material character, restrained semantic palette, and protected copy-safe region. Avoid all prohibited drift.

rights_and_privacy.privacy_review: No private person, client data, or identifying project material may enter the prompt or output.
